cast.name: Professor Jar
cast.description: talking DERMDOC Kojic Acid night cream jar wearing round glasses and holding a pointer, teaching a mini night class; playful, bossy-but-fun cartoon teacher voice

cast.name: Kojic Acid
cast.description: golden spiky Kojic Acid ingredient hero who points at the Dark Spot villain; confident, punchy, upbeat cartoon voice

cast.name: Niacinamide
cast.description: silver-white Niacinamide ingredient hero who sweeps away the grey Dullness villain; light, airy, sparkly cartoon voice, higher than Kojic Acid

cast.name: Narrator
cast.description: off-screen brand voiceover over the end frame; warm, clear, polished ad narrator

lines.speaker: professor_jar
lines.en: Class is in session. Tonight's lesson: brighter, even-looking skin.
lines.bn: ক্লাস শুরু! আজ রাতের লেসন, ব্রাইটার আর ইভন লুকিং স্কিন।
lines.ta: கிளாஸ் ஆரம்பம்! இன்னைக்கு லெசன், ப்ரைட்டர், ஈவன் லுக்கிங் ஸ்கின்.
lines.te: క్లాస్ మొదలు! ఈ రాత్రి లెసన్, బ్రైటర్, ఈవెన్ లుకింగ్ స్కిన్.
lines.ml: ക്ലാസ് തുടങ്ങി! ഇന്നത്തെ ലെസൺ, ബ്രൈറ്റർ, ഈവൻ ലുക്കിങ് സ്കിൻ.
lines.or: କ୍ଲାସ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ! ଆଜି ରାତିର ଲେସନ, ବ୍ରାଇଟର ଆଉ ଇଭେନ ଲୁକିଙ୍ଗ ସ୍କିନ।

lines.speaker: kojic_acid
lines.en: Lesson one: target stubborn dark spots.
lines.bn: লেসন ওয়ান, জেদি ডার্ক স্পটদের টার্গেট করো!
lines.ta: லெசன் ஒன், அடங்காத டார்க் ஸ்பாட்ஸ் டார்கெட்!
lines.te: లెసన్ వన్, మొండి డార్క్ స్పాట్స్ టార్గెట్!
lines.ml: ലെസൺ വൺ, മുരടൻ ഡാർക്ക് സ്പോട്ട്സ് ടാർഗെറ്റ്!
lines.or: ଲେସନ ୱାନ, ଜିଦିଆ ଡାର୍କ ସ୍ପଟକୁ ଟାର୍ଗେଟ କର!

lines.speaker: niacinamide
lines.en: Lesson two: brighter skin. Three: even-looking tone.
lines.bn: লেসন টু, ব্রাইটার স্কিন। থ্রি, ইভন লুকিং টোন!
lines.ta: லெசன் டூ, ப்ரைட்டர் ஸ்கின். த்ரீ, ஈவன் லுக்கிங் டோன்!
lines.te: లెసన్ టూ, బ్రైటర్ స్కిన్. త్రీ, ఈవెన్ లుకింగ్ టోన్!
lines.ml: ലെസൺ ടൂ, ബ്രൈറ്റർ സ്കിൻ. ത്രീ, ഈവൻ ലുക്കിങ് ടോൺ!
lines.or: ଲେସନ ଟୁ, ବ୍ରାଇଟର ସ୍କିନ। ଥ୍ରୀ, ଇଭେନ ଲୁକିଂ ଟୋନ!

lines.speaker: professor_jar
lines.en: Rich cream. Apply at night, and let the team get to work.
lines.bn: রিচ ক্রিম। রাতে লাগাও, বাকি কাজ টিমের।
lines.ta: ரிச் க்ரீம். நைட்ல தடவுங்க, மீதி டீம் பாத்துக்கும்!
lines.te: రిచ్ క్రీమ్. నైట్ అప్లై చెయ్, మిగతాది టీమ్ చూసుకుంటుంది!
lines.ml: റിച്ച് ക്രീം. രാത്രി പുരട്ടൂ, ബാക്കി ടീം നോക്കിക്കോളും!
lines.or: ରିଚ କ୍ରିମ। ରାତିରେ ଲଗାଅ, ବାକି କାମ ଟିମ୍ କରିବ!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: After two weeks, spots look reduced. Class dismissed!
lines.bn: দুই সপ্তাহে স্পট কম লাগছে। ক্লাস ছুটি!
lines.ta: ரெண்டு வாரத்துல ஸ்பாட்ஸ் கம்மியா தெரியுது. கிளாஸ் ஓவர்!
lines.te: రెండు వారాల్లో స్పాట్స్ తగ్గినట్టున్నాయి. క్లాస్ ఖతం!
lines.or: ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତାହରେ ସ୍ପଟ୍ସ କମ ଦିଶୁଛି। କ୍ଲାସ ଛୁଟି!

notes: Speaker split follows prompt.txt labels; Whisper merged everything into 3 segments, so lines were split at word timings. Alpha Arbutin's 'Lesson three' line was NOT spoken in this video (cut), so it is not dubbed; the on-screen pink Alpha Arbutin appears around ~9.5 s while the audio is still Niacinamide's 'Lesson two' line (source A/V deviation, kept audio as-is). Kojic and Niacinamide lessons sit in one Whisper segment (f0 ~205 Hz, 0.24 s gap) and may be the same generated voice, so they get +1 / +3 st to stay distinct. Segment 10.84-16.5 has a lower median f0 (~162 Hz) than the opening jar voice (~195 Hz): line 5 is cast as Professor Jar per the prompt, but if it actually sounds like the end-frame narrator, reassign it to narrator. Jar refs exclude 10.84-13.34 for that reason. The three villains (Dark Spot, Dullness, Uneven Tone) appear on screen but never speak. Video is 17.02 s (prompt planned 20 s); 'After 2 Weeks' section has no dialogue. KNC kept as spelled-out letters. Text pass (client feedback EDL): L4 now 'Lesson two: brighter skin. Three: even-looking tone.' so Alpha Arbutin gets its beat; L6 says the full product name instead of 'KNC' (dubs say 'DERMDOC Kojic Acid Night Cream' without 'two percent' to fit the 2.96 s slot with 'Class dismissed').
